Class TextCriteria

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.TextCriteria
All Implemented Interfaces:
CriteriaDefinition
public class TextCriteria extends Object implements CriteriaDefinition
实现CriteriaDefinition，用于全文搜索。
